applies_to: AI semantic repairs and editorial changes
core_rule: WHEN AN EDIT IS APPROVED/VERIFIED, APPLY IT TO THE CURRENT EDITABLE AUTHORITY IN THE SAME WORK TURN, TEST THE ACTUAL EDITED DATA, AND PERSIST IT. A candidate-only report must never replace a safe permitted data edit.
execution_order: Resolve exact newest CURRENT mutable artifact and verify bytes/hash; check Git latest and concurrent writer
Analyze proposed change and registered source; separate truly correct changes from no-force and holds
Apply every approved safe edit directly to the identified mutable working file immediately, with before/after stable IDs and original source frozen
Run modified-scope and affected-dependency QA on actual post-edit working content, with source/LOCKED preservation, duplicate and negative mutation guards
Write source patch and refreshed working content to durable file or portable recovery; attempt bounded Git sync; record persisted paths/hashes and live currentness
Only report APPLIED counts for edits whose post-edit bytes were verified; report PENDING when not applied, with exact blocker and recovery path

nonnegotiable_guards.original_registered_sources: IMMUTABLE; make source-derived editable fields and separately provenanced new curated examples
nonnegotiable_guards.locked_artifacts: READ_ONLY; no silent rewrite; successors only via explicit reviewed branch/approved scope
nonnegotiable_guards.exact_current_missing: Never silently apply to an older v034 while pretending v037. Recover exact v037; in parallel apply source-only safe fixes to a clearly separate source-derived working artifact and upload/commit it, labeling not v037. Do NOT advance official v037 QA counts.
nonnegotiable_guards.visual_ui: No noticeable UI change without prior user approval
nonnegotiable_guards.concurrency: One writer, re-fetch latest Sha/CAS before writing; reject conflicts and persist non-authoritative patch
nonnegotiable_guards.translation: Do not replace source-exact German quote; add independent DE/FA/EN curated example as needed
nonnegotiable_guards.human_signoff: Only documented AI linguistic and independent-method second pass; no outside human mandatory

anti_patterns: Repeated NOT-APPLIED reports for the same already approved corrections while mutable current data is writable
Claiming Stage4 progress from original-source audit or older-version patch
Creating many tiny ZIPs/reports instead of cumulative direct edits
Inventing verification or declaring Git-backed final without write/readback

if_edit_cannot_be_applied.mandatory_action: State why precisely; create/source and verify recoverable working patch/artifact if independently useful; do not portray it as target integration; fix authority persistence before resuming edits to missing target.

completion_definition: Change is only complete when before/after diff on working file, targeted test and durable recovery evidence all exist; otherwise status remains PENDING/NOT_APPLIED.
incident_record: Menschen A2 repeated source and v034 proposal reports while v037 lost and user explicitly expected immediate application. 2026-10-26 fixes: 2249-row derived editable A2 source, 95 edits, uploaded Library exact SHA readback; official v037 remains missing.
